sections.content: Hungarian names days of the week and uses time expressions. Frequency adverbs 'mindig' (always) and 'néha' (sometimes) say how often something happens.

items.english: On Monday morning we are at home.

items.spanish: Én mindig reggel dolgozom, de néha otthon tanulok.
items.english: I always work in the morning, but sometimes I study at home.

sections.content: Days of the week take -n suffix for 'on that day': 'hétfőn' (on Monday). The suffix shows the time when something happens.
